subject: Trust portal: timeboxed auditor access and evidence pull for SOC 2
messages:
From: Rebecca Walsh <auditor@grayshore-audit.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Jones <emma.jones@acme-health.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: scoped auditor workspace and timeboxed access for SOC 2 Type II evidence pull

Hi Markus,

Grayshore is starting fieldwork for Acme Health's SOC 2 Type II (period May 1 — Oct 31, 2026). We need read-only, download-capable access to Redwood's trust portal to retrieve the control evidence bundle and any bridge letters that cover the remainder of the period.

Requirements:
- 7-day window (preferred start 2026-12-14) with enforced expiration
- Auditor-only scope: read + download (no admin)
- MFA requirement if possible; if not, short-lived temporary credentials are acceptable
- Access to the evidence folder: /Acme-Health/SOC2-2026/Attachments and the SOC2 report PDF

Please let us know whether you can:
1) create an ephemeral guest account or SSO one-time link, and
2) confirm whether a bridge letter covering Nov–Dec 2026 can be shared (if SOC 2 report end date is Oct 31).

Also copy any portal invite link or DocuSign/HubSpot ticket for our tracker.

Thanks,
Rebecca Walsh
Senior IT Audit Manager
Grayshore Audit

Attachment: auditor-credentials-guidelines.txt (attachment stub)
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Rebecca Walsh <auditor@grayshore-audit.com>
Cc: Emma Jones <emma.jones@acme-health.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: scoped auditor workspace and timeboxed access for SOC 2 Type II evidence pull

Rebecca —

Thanks for the heads up. We can provision a timeboxed auditor workspace with read/download only, and we will enforce expiration. Two quick asks so we scope correctly:
- Confirm the exact start date/time you want the window to open (we can do 2026-12-14 08:00 PST as suggested)
- Do you need access to raw logs (audit/event logs) or only the control evidence bundle and reports?

Next steps from our side:
- I'll loop in Neha (Security & Compliance) and Marissa (Trust Portal ops) to create the guest and schedule automatic revocation.
- We typically provide a one-time SAML SSO link if the auditor accepts SSO; otherwise we issue temporary guest credentials valid for the chosen window.
- We will attach a bridge letter draft if requested for Nov–Dec coverage.

I'll cc the provisioning ticket once created (will include the portal link and removal timestamp).

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Start window: 2026-12-14 08:00 PST is fine. We will need: control evidence, encryption key rotation logs (last six months), and system change approvals for services used by Acme (tickets and approvals). Raw ingestion logs are not required.

SSO would be preferred; if you can issue a SAML one-time admission link that would work best. MFA is required for the auditor account.

Cc: Emma — I'm copying you so you can confirm any internal objections to the scope.

Regards,
Rebecca

Ticket/links: https://support.redwood.com/tickets/TKT-3319 (create if you prefer)

Thanks — looping you both so we have a clear audit trail.

-Markus
